rationale: Accept only the existing R3 integration/quality closeout, not retrospective approval of R3 implementation. The bounded Actions validation surface is an execution mechanism, not a new discovery or monitoring workflow.

dimensions.problem_solution_fit: The missing gate is executable pinned validation, not more search or a new corpus; reuse PR #445 unchanged unless a proven defect requires repair.
dimensions.alternatives: A Work checkout would be simpler but is unavailable from this session. One bounded branch-specific GitHub Actions job is the least intrusive executable alternative.
dimensions.architecture_tradeoffs: Keep the canonical Agent OS scripts and exact hash pins; checkout alongside Culinary in the existing GitHub runner and leave public runtime unchanged.
dimensions.complexity: Limit new code to a branch-scoped validation workflow and versioned quality evidence/receipt; do not create a generalized quality orchestration service.
dimensions.security_compliance: No additional provider access, keys or permissions needed; CI read-only checkout and no publication until gate.
dimensions.cost: Existing normal GitHub Actions allowance only; forbid new paid calls and limit retries to the inherited bounded round.
dimensions.failure_scenarios: Hash mismatch, stale roadmap, unverified knowledge provenance, source evidence uncertainty, changed PR head, or missing sidecar must HOLD not merge.
dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Require exact 44 occurrence decisions, five-source counts by unique practitioner, 40 conservative NEEDS_EVIDENCE, quality receipt and final-head CI.
dimensions.roadmap_alignment: Barbecue isolated lane P2 under standing policy; owner-requested recovery has an authorized bounded continuation and does not block main acquisition.
